results.rationale: Consistency: two white clocks and wall remain, but both clocks shift position and their face lettering/hand details change. Instruction: left clock remains visibly smaller than the right and is not meaningfully enlarged to match; requested sizing fails. Quality: coherent round clock forms, readable numerals, plausible hands and shadows, no noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: the white pump silhouette, toe, heel, seam, sole and position remain visually unchanged; surrounding poster additions are requested. Instruction: gold glitter/floral lines, soft gray-white background and title are present, but the headline is script rather than bold uppercase and the slogan omits “elegance”; partial compliance. Quality: attractive coherent shoe and poster, but the lower slogan reads incompletely and the added tiny footer is garbled.
